newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RIVALRY HEATS UP AS REAL BID FOR KEY BARCELONA DEFENDER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIVALRY HEATS UP AS REAL BID FOR KEY BARCELONA DEFENDER.

text.p: Real Madrid have made a bid to buy international defender Albert Ferrer from Barcelona in a move seen in Spain as a deliberate ploy to disrupt their arch-rivals.
Ferrer, who missed this year's European championship through injury and only recently reappeared in the league, acknowledged that he had received "an important offer" from Real.
"It's a manoeuvre to make us nervous," said Barcelona vice-president Joan Gaspart. "My patience is reaching its limit and if it gets there it won't be good for anybody."
The news came just days after Barcelona reportedly doubled Real's bid for Sampdoria's French midfielder Christian Karembeu.
